The '''K220 heavy-duty peripheral processor'''<ref name="VotF" /> was a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] package that was manufactured by [[Wickstrom]]. It was designed to allow the off-loading of tasks during data transmissions.<ref name="CSWE" />

In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> during the [[Caamas Document Crisis|crisis]] caused by the discovery of the [[Caamas Document]], which implicated members of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in the [[Caamas Firestorm|destruction]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Crypt Chief]] [[Zakarisz Ghent]] volunteered to accompany [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Hestiv]] to attempt to recover an original copy of the document from a [[Ubiqtorate base|station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the planet [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]] run by the [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]],<ref name="VotF" /> the unit that oversaw [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]].<ref name="CSWEUbiqtorate">{{CSWECite|III|275|Ubiqtorate}}</ref> Ghent was provided with a room and equipment to aid him in his work, including five K220 heavy-duty peripheral processors. Ghent used the K220s to perform a complex analysis, the results of which he transferred to a [[Masterline-70 OcTerminal]] to continue his work.<ref name="VotF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The K220 heavy-duty peripheral processor first appeared in the [[1998]] [[Timothy Zahn]] novel ''[[Vision of the Future]]'', the second installment of ''[[Star Wars: The Hand of Thrawn Duology]]''.<ref name="VotF" />
